settings.title: What is this for?
settings.content:
• Licensed estheticians and skincare professionals
  • Advanced home users familiar with microcurrent facial techniques
  • Individuals focusing on precise facial areas such as:
  1. Around the eyes
  2. Nasolabial folds
  3. Lip contours
  4. Forehead lines
  5. Eyebrows and upper eyelids

settings.title: How to use it?
settings.content:
1. Prepare the Tips:
    Use paper-stemmed cotton swabs and trim them to 1/4–1/2 inch length.
  2. Saturate:
    Soak the trimmed tips in 7E's Infused Conductive Solution
  3. Insert:
    Place the damp cotton tips into each side of the handle.
  4. Attach to Device:
    Plug the handle into your MyoLift™ device as instructed in your model’s manual.
  5. Perform Treatment:
    Use light pressure and "pinch-and-hold" movements for targeted muscle lifting and contouring.

⚠️ Pro Tip: Avoid using wooden or plastic-stem cotton swabs as they can interfere with conductivity.

settings.content:

settings.title: Product Features
settings.content:
Universal Compatibility: Works with MyoLift™ Mini, 600, QT+, MD, and Triwave devices.

 Pinpoint Precision: Perfect for "pinch-and-hold" techniques on eyes, lips, forehead, and brows.

 Disposable Tip Design: Requires use of paper (not wood or plastic) cotton tips for optimal conductivity.

 Ergonomic Handle: Long, slim handle offers comfort and better control during treatments.

 Professional Grade: Developed for estheticians, spas, and advanced home users.

settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.title1: Which MyoLift™ devices are compatible with the Cotton Tip Handle?
settings.text1: The Cotton Tip Handle is compatible with all MyoLift™ devices, including the Mini, 600, QT+, MD, and Triwave models.
settings.title2: What type of cotton tips should I use with this handle?
settings.text2: Only paper-stemmed cotton swabs should be used. Avoid wooden or plastic stems, as they interfere with conductivity and can affect treatment performance.
settings.title3: Do I need a conductive gel with this accessory?
settings.text3: Yes, for best results, saturate the cotton tips with 7E’s Infused Conductive Solution before inserting them into the handle.
settings.title4: Can beginners use this, or is it just for professionals?
settings.text4: This tool is designed for licensed estheticians and advanced home users who are comfortable with microcurrent techniques, especially the "pinch-and-hold" method.
settings.title5: What areas can I treat with the Cotton Tip Handle?
settings.text5: It's ideal for delicate and targeted areas including the under-eyes, nasolabial folds, lips, forehead lines, brows, and upper eyelids.
settings.title6: How do I clean the handle between uses?
settings.text6: Since the cotton tips are disposable, simply remove and discard them after each session. Wipe the handle down with a soft cloth and alcohol-free cleanser to maintain hygiene.
